summary: More community.crypto removals in Ansible 12: CRYPTOGRAPHY_HAS_* flags, cryptography_serial_number_of_cert, the module_backends.common utils, the pyopenssl backend (including openssl_pkcs12), ecs_certificate and ecs_domain, the entrust provider of x509_certificate(_pipe), and check mode in openssl_csr_pipe, openssl_privatekey_pipe and x509_certificate_pipe.
questions: Why does x509_certificate_pipe ignore check mode?
